scope: Base-field Q_p statements over imported LocalFieldAudit and Mathlib; external libraries stay metadata, not fact-tree nodes.

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (k : ℤ),
  IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p (IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p k) k

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  ¬IUTBridge.Admissibility.IsRectangular (IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p)
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p (LinearEquiv.refl ℚ_[p] ℚ_[p]) 0

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (e : ℚ_[p] ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p]) {k m : ℤ},
  IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p e k → IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p e m → k = m

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  (∀ (e : ℚ_[p] ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p]), IUTBridge.Admissibility.LeftAllowed (IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p) e) ∧
    (∀ (k : ℤ), IUTBridge.Admissibility.RightAllowed (IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p) k) ∧
      ¬IUTBridge.Admissibility.IsRectangular (IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p)

∀ {K : Type u} {S : Type v} {A : K → S → Prop},
  (∀ (k : K) (s s' : S), A k s → A k s' → s = s') →
    (∀ (k : K), IUTBridge.Admissibility.LeftAllowed A k) →
      (∀ (s : S), IUTBridge.Admissibility.RightAllowed A s) →
        ∀ {k1 k2 : K} {s1 s2 : S},
          A k1 s1 →
            A k2 s2 →
              s1 ≠ s2 →
                (∀ (k : K), IUTBridge.Admissibility.LeftAllowed A k) ∧
                  (∀ (s : S), IUTBridge.Admissibility.RightAllowed A s) ∧ ¬IUTBridge.Admissibility.IsRectangular A

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  (∀ (e : ℚ_[p] ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p]), IUTBridge.Admissibility.LeftAllowed (IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p) e) ∧
    ∀ (k : ℤ), IUTBridge.Admissibility.RightAllowed (IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p) k

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  IUTBridge.Admissibility.IsRectangular fun e k => IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p e k ∧ k = 0

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (k : ℤ),
  IUTBridge.Admissibility.RightAllowed (fun e k => IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p e k ∧ k = 0) k ↔ k = 0

∀ {K : Type u} {S : Type v} {A : K → S → Prop},
  (∀ (k : K) (s s' : S), A k s → A k s' → s = s') →
    ∀ {k1 k2 : K} {s1 s2 : S}, A k1 s1 → A k2 s2 → s1 ≠ s2 → ¬IUTBridge.Admissibility.IsRectangular A

∀ {K : Type u} {S : Type v} (A : K → S → Prop),
  IUTBridge.Admissibility.IsRectangular A ↔
    ∀ (k : K) (s : S), A k s ↔ IUTBridge.Admissibility.LeftAllowed A k ∧ IUTBridge.Admissibility.RightAllowed A s

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (R : (ℚ_[p] ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p]) → ℤ → Prop),
  (∀ (e : ℚ_[p] ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p]) (k : ℤ), R e k → IUTBridge.Admissibility.LatticeAdmissible p e k) →
    IUTBridge.Admissibility.IsRectangular R → ∀ {e1 e2 : ℚ_[p] ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p]} {k1 k2 : ℤ}, R e1 k1 → R e2 k2 → k1 = k2

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (l : List ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]),
  (IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.composeShift p l) x = ↑p ^ l.sum * x

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (l : List ℤ),
  IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.composeShift p l = IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p l.sum

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (k m : ℤ),
  ⇑(IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p (m - k)) '' IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p k = IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p m

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (e : ℚ_[p] ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p]),
  ∃! k, ⇑e '' LocalFieldAudit.Filtration.ball p = IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p k

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (e : ℚ_[p] ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p]),
  ⇑e '' LocalFieldAudit.Filtration.ball p = IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p (e 1).valuation

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n k : ℤ),
  ⇑(IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p n) '' IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p k = IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p (k + n)
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], Function.Injective (IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p)
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {k m : ℤ}, k < m → IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p m ⊂ IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p k
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {k m : ℤ}, k ≤ m → IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p m ⊆ IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p k
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (e : ℚ_[p] ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p]) (x : ℚ_[p]), e x = e 1 * x
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (k : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]), x ≠ 0 → (x ∈ IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p k ↔ k ≤ x.valuation)
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (k : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]), x ∈ IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p k ↔ ‖x‖ ≤ ↑p ^ (-k)

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n m : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]),
  ‖(IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p n) ((IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p m) x)‖ = ↑p ^ (-n) * (↑p ^ (-m) * ‖x‖)

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n m : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]),
  ‖(IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p n) ((IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p m) x)‖ = ↑p ^ (-(n + m)) * ‖x‖
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]), ‖(IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p n) x‖ = ↑p ^ (-n) * ‖x‖
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]), (IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p n) x = ↑p ^ n * x

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n m : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]),
  (IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p n) ((IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p m) x) = (IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p (n + m)) x
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]), x ≠ 0 → (IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p n) x ≠ 0

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n m : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]),
  x ≠ 0 → ((IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p n) ((IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p m) x)).valuation = n + m + x.valuation

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : ℤ) (x : ℚ_[p]),
  x ≠ 0 → ((IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.shift p n) x).valuation = n + x.valuation
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (k : ℤ), 0 ∈ IUTBridge.ScaleLedger.layer p k
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), Function.Injective (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ)

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p])
  (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n),
  IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a x) =
    IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p (fun j => a ((Equiv.symm σ) j)) (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ x)

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n),
  IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p τ x) = IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p (Equiv.trans τ σ) x

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p]),
  (∀ (j : Fin n), a ((Equiv.symm σ) j) = a j) →
    ∀ (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n),
      IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a x) =
        IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ x)

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p]) (j : Fin n),
  a ((Equiv.symm σ) j) ≠ a j →
    ∃ x,
      IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a x) ≠
        IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ x)

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p 4),
  IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p IUTBridge.Slots.swap23 x 2 = x 3 ∧
    IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p IUTBridge.Slots.swap23 x 3 = x 2

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p 4),
  IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p IUTBridge.Slots.swap23 x 0 = x 0 ∧
    IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p IUTBridge.Slots.swap23 x 1 = x 1

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (c : ℚ_[p]) (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n),
  IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p (fun x => c) x) =
    IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p (fun x => c) (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ x)

∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p]) (x : IUTBridge.Slots.Tuple p n)
  (j : Fin n),
  a ((Equiv.symm σ) j) ≠ 0 →
    x ((Equiv.symm σ) j) ≠ 0 →
      (IUTBridge.Slots.relabel p σ (IUTBridge.Slots.slotwise p a x) j).valuation =
        (a ((Equiv.symm σ) j)).valuation + (x ((Equiv.symm σ) j)).valuation
